conditions.C: Same recipe plus explicit conditional execution-first routing paragraph

integrity: Use unchanged task/oracle/prompt and exact prior A/B/C binaries. Freeze both stages before launch; sequential arms, no outcome-dependent order changes. Keep all valid failures and costs. Invalid context/model/telemetry makes the affected stage inadmissible; do not silently replace trials. Retain existing per-run budgets and audit final counters.
review: Independent final-answer review with condition/resource labels hidden. Answers can reveal their route, so blinding is imperfect.

decision_rule.correctness: Every C run must pass executable artifacts and independent semantic grading; no lower pass count than A or B. Valid incomplete/failed/budget-limited runs remain in costs and fail correctness when in C.
decision_rule.primary_guard: C median agent calls <=A; C median uncached input <=105% of A.
decision_rule.secondary_guard: For shell executions, CLI invocations, cached input, output including reasoning, duration, guide calls and schema calls, C median must be <=120% of BOTH A and B medians. Positive C versus zero comparator fails; no division by zero.
decision_rule.interpretation: Practical diagnostic decision, not statistical significance, equivalence, proof of absence, or a general no-regression guarantee. Prior covered-task benefit remains the original four repetitions. No automatic production installation.

paired_directions: For EACH failed primary metric against A, classify its penalty direction as consistent only when strict C>A occurs in >=9 of12 pairs; ties do not count. A primary failure lacking this consistency is mixed/inconclusive, not established harm. A secondary-only failure is a guard failure, not evidence of a consistent primary penalty.
stopping_rule: After all36 stage1 sessions and independent grading: if inadmissible or any gate fails, stop and retain current help; no extra trials or wording change. If all gates pass, run the already frozen18-session stage2. After stage2 stop: both admissible stages passing supports a narrow adoption recommendation; otherwise retain current help. Do not pool prior runs or continue until favorable.
